condition.user_goal_task_flow: Remove an API token after reviewing the consequence
condition.success_condition: Understand the consequence, choose whether to proceed, and safely leave by keyboard.

pattern_identifications.purpose: Temporarily place a task above the primary view while preserving a safe way to complete or leave it.
pattern_identifications.user_goal_relationship: The dialog interrupts token settings to confirm a destructive action.
pattern_identifications.applicability: The task interrupts the settings view and presents a modal choice.

evaluations.target: Modal dialog focus and keyboard dismissal
evaluations.observed_fact: After Tab moved beyond the dialog, the background Create API token button became active while the dialog remained open. Escape left the dialog open.
evaluations.expected_characteristic: Keyboard interaction remains within the modal dialog and provides a way to dismiss or complete the task.
evaluations.difference: Focus escaped to an obscured background control and Escape did not dismiss the dialog.
evaluations.expected_impact: A keyboard user may leave the intended task context and may lack a discoverable way to leave without activating the destructive action.
evaluations.impact_basis: The saved keyboard trace shows focus on the background trigger while the dialog remained open; no user frequency is inferred.
evaluations.judgment_reason: The evidence supports an interaction concern under the informative APG dialog keyboard guidance. This does not change the supplied TC PASS and is not a formal WCAG result.
evaluations.note: TC-001 remains PASS; this is a separate UI/UX evaluation.
